typography.font_strategy: The Old Money Tech (Classic Serif + Clean Sans + Technical Mono)
rules: NEVER use Inter, Roboto, or generic fonts for headings.
Use JetBrains Mono for all financial values, percentages, and dates.
Overlines must be Uppercase + Tiny + Wide Spacing (tracking-[0.2em]).
No full-screen gradients. Flat colors only.
Never use pure black or grey without a tint. All greys must lean slightly warm.
Only use Primary Accent (#0F291E) for CTAs and critical states.
Profit/Gain uses Deep Emerald, Loss/Expense uses Deep Rose/Terra Cotta.

layouts.strategy: High Density Grid (Mode B) + Grid Borders (The Technical Look)
layouts.spacing: Dense internally (p-4 to p-6 for cards), but generous margins between sections (gap-8).
layouts.sidebar: Left sidebar, fixed width (240px or 280px). No hamburger on desktop.
layouts.kpi_cards: Single row KPI cards. Use Grid Borders (border-collapse style layout).
layouts.data_tables: Compact, dense rows. Numbers must be right-aligned and mono-spaced. Text left-aligned.

surfaces.cards: Flat background (bg-white), 1px subtle border (border-border), no shadow. Rounded-sm (2px or 4px max).
surfaces.hover_state: Slight lift (-translate-y-px) and border color darkens. No massive shadows.
surfaces.glassmorphism: Not recommended for financial apps as it reduces readability. Use solid backgrounds for modals/dropdowns.
rules: Never apply transparent background for dropdowns or modals.
Maintain crisp, technical edges to feel like a high-end ledger.
Do NOT use 'transition: all'. Target specific properties (e.g., transition-colors, transition-transform).
No bouncy/springy animations. Use ease-out for quick, snappy responses.

customizations.cards: Override Shadcn Card to be flat with 1px border and sharp corners (rounded-sm).
customizations.buttons: Primary: bg-[#0F291E] text-white hover:bg-slate-800. Sharp corners.
customizations.charts: Recharts. Use subtle strokes. No gradients in charts, use solid or patterned fills. Colors: Emerald for Income, Rose for Expense.

patterns.accountant_export: Step-based wizard flow. 1: Scope, 2: Format, 3: Review. Use progress indicator.
patterns.missing_expense_reminders: Contextual alerts below KPI row, using warning accents.
patterns.quick_add: Persistent sticky header button in primary brand color for '+ Add'.

icons_and_assets.usage: Use sparingly. Mono-line icons. Size 16px to 20px max for UI elements.

rules: Text contrast must meet APCA / WCAG AA standards.
Include data-testid on all interactive and key informational elements (e.g., data-testid='add-expense-btn').
Focus states must have 2px offset ring.
Do not rely solely on red/green for financial metrics; use explicit (+)/(-) signs or arrows.

universal_guidelines: Build 'urbandotted expense book' as a premium, light-theme Australian SaaS application.
Avoid 'AI slop' by strictly following the typographic hierarchy and font pairings (Cormorant Garamond + Manrope + JetBrains Mono).
DO NOT use generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
All financial values must use JetBrains Mono and align correctly.
Use sonner for all toast notifications.
Implement the 'Month-End' and 'Accountant Export' flows as detailed step-by-step wizards.
Do not use transparent backgrounds on elements that overlap content (e.g., dropdowns, sticky headers).
Ensure all date formats are Australian (DD/MM/YYYY) and currency is AUD ($).
Apply the 'data-testid' attribute to all interactive elements for robust testing.
